LESSON: PHYSICAL AND CHEMICAL CHANGES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Mixtures, Elements and Compounds
Topic 1.2: Physical and chemical changes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Physical and chemical changes
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does the movement of particles in matter affect its properties?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the characteristics of particles in the three states of matter
2. explain the effects of impurities on boiling point and melting point of a substance
3. appreciate the applications of change of state of matter in

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Physical and chemical changes

Teach
• Observe Physical and chemical changes in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

• Fact 1 about Physical and chemical changes (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Physical and chemical changes.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Physical and chemical changes.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Physical and chemical changes.
• Say one safety rule.

• appreciate the applications of change of state of matter in

2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.
